page.overview:
Who is Bumblebee?

Bumblebee was employed as courier because of his speed and small size. He can get in places most normal sized bots can't, which makes him perfect for sabotage. Bumblebee joins the Autobots as Megatron begins his insurrection.

During the war on Cybertron, Bumblebee and Cliffjumper rescued Arcee from a Decepticon named Airachnid. At another point during the war, at Tyger Pax, Bumblebee was captured by Decepticons and interrogated by . After refusing to speak, Megatron beat him and left the severely damaged Bumblebee for dead. However, a squadron of Autobots later arrived and brought him to a field medic, who was able to repair all but his voice box.

After a Decepticon attack left Cliffjumper dead, Bumblebee kept an eye on the emotional Arcee and assisted her and a human teenager that were being attacked by two Vehicons, doing his best to slow them down as Arcee found a stormdrain to do battle in. During the fight, Bumblebee accidentally stood on another boy’s remote control car, and apologized, before being attacked again, and kept the Vehicons from catching the escaping humans. Once Bulkhead arrived and drove off the Vehicons, he and Arcee reported the incident to Optimus, who decided that they needed to protect the two humans. Bumblebee collected Raf from his school and brought him to the Autobot base.

Bumblebee first runs into Optimus and Ratchet after they save him from some Decepticons. Ratchet tries to repair him but he's in too much of a hurry. He tells him that he is looking for an Autobot called Optimus. Optimus reveals himself, and Bumblebee tells him that Zeta Prime is dead. They continue to a small Autobot base where they receive a holographic message from Jetfire telling them they need the planetary cannons online. Optimus relays the message to Jetfire that Zeta Prime is dead. Bumblebee then accompanies Ratchet and Optimus on their journey to the Decagon, and helps defeat Starscream. Interestingly, he calls Starscream a yellow-plated coward despite the fact he is yellow. This is probably just a twist on the real-life old-fashioned statement "yellow-bellied coward". Bumblebee is also yellow in the belly.

Also known as: Bee, Bumble Bee.
